card.name: The word no in reserve-for-use warnings
card.fires_on: The word "no" in fluoroquinolone boxed warnings, right after "patients who have" or "when there are" and before "alternative treatment options". Weaker on "'s" after "assess each patient".

modes.label: No alternative options
modes.description: The word "no" in a reserve-for-use warning, just before "alternative" treatment or antibacterial options.
modes.example: reserve CIPRO for use in patients who have<< no>> alternative treatment options for the following indications:

modes.label: Assess each patient's risk
modes.description: The possessive after "assess each patient" in opioid risk statements.
modes.example: assess each patient<<'s>> risk prior to prescribing and reassess all
